<thought>We need a template that describes a Friedel‑Crafts acylation: an aryl halide (halide) is replaced by an acyl group, forming a ketone on the aromatic ring and breaking the C–Cl bond. The valid functional group for the product is “ketones”. We'll search the template catalog for reactions that break a halide and form a ketone, forming a new C–C bond (6-6).</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CCl)cc3)c2N)c1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["halide"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["ketones"],
    "bonds_formed": ["6-6"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
